department: Department of Mathematics, Courant Institute (Ph.D. in Mathematics)

deadline.value: January 4 for Ph.D. program admission (year inferred for Fall 2027 entry).
deadline.quote: Admission to the Ph.D. program - January 4

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject Test is expected; if it is not practical, a short statement explaining why must be attached.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants are expected to submit their GRE Mathematics Subject Test score. | If taking this test is not practical for an applicant, they must attach a short statement to their application explaining why they were not able to take the GRE Mathematics Subject Test.

supervisor.value: Admission decisions are based on committee review of academic record, recommendation letters, and credentials; no prior supervisor required before applying.
supervisor.quote: Admission decisions are based on a careful review of the applicant's previous academic record, letters of recommendation, TOEFL (if applicable) and GRE scores, as well as other credentials, such as work experience or previous research projects.

funding.value: The main award, GSAS MacCracken support, is highly competitive and based on academic merit.
funding.quote: This highly competitive award, available to students applying to the full-time Ph.D. program, is based solely on academic merit.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a B.A. or B.S. can apply straight to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Students with B.A./B.S. degrees may apply directly to the Ph.D. program.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is neither required nor accepted for the Mathematics PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test Scores are neither required nor accepted as part of the application.

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose bachelor's or master's was taught in English need no test; others need TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: Either the TOEFL or the IELTS is required of all applicants who are not native English speakers or who do not have a bachelor's or master's degree from an institution where the language of instruction is English.
